notes: Premises are true at one world; distinguished from model-global and frame-global consequence.

notes: Canonical neighborhoods can differ on subsets outside this Boolean algebra.

notes: A member contains some original member; an empty family remains empty.

notes: Pointwise conversion requires augmentation; filter completeness alone does not establish a principal representation.

notes: The empty-family intersection is W; an augmented family contains its core.

notes: Outside this subset box is always false; Boolean truth remains classical.

role: unboxed members of a maximal theory used in the relational canonical construction
notes: Finite conjunction consistency supplies successors; the zero-member case uses unit or necessitation explicitly.

notes: Tracked truth sets are saturated; arbitrary images are not presumed to preserve intersections.

notes: Inconsistent descriptions have no representative; the construction is not a consistency decision algorithm.

notes: The empty subset label is a contradiction; labels are Boolean combinations of the subformula observations.

notes: Agreement is proved on observations their Boolean closure and boxes of that closure; not every arbitrary iterated formula.

role: general-frame admissible Boolean algebra and neighborhood membership operation
notes: The canonical algebra is PL; admissible valuation completeness is distinct from unrestricted ordinary-frame completeness.
